panels.title: Wind — Right Now (at anchor: true wind direction, computed)
Apparent Wind Speed
panels.description: sensor.nmea_aws_live — the boat's own masthead instrument reading, not corrected for boat motion.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws_live")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "aws")

panels.title: True Wind Speed

panels.title: 6h Max True Wind Speed

panels.title: True Wind — Last 5 min (TWD + AWS)
panels.description: Last five 1-minute TWD+AWS readings. Newest petal is brightest; each older minute fades. Petal length is AWS (knots); petal and ring colors are the same kn buckets as the other roses (<2 / 2–5 / 5–7 / 7–10 / 10–15 / 15–20 / 20+). Concentric rings sit on those bucket edges. N is up.

targets.query:
dir = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_twd_live")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "wind_direction" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
spd = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws_live")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "wind_speed" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
union(tables: [dir, spd])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.wind_direction and exists r.wind_speed)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "wind_direction", "wind_speed"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> tail(n: 5)
  |> yield(name: "rose")

panels.title: Wind Trend — Last Hour (fixed window, 1min resolution)
Wind Speed — Last Hour
panels.description: Apparent only (AWS, the raw masthead instrument reading) — TWS is the instrument's own AWS+SOG+heading correction, which is a no-op at anchor (SOG≈0), so it'd just retrace AWS on this dashboard. See WeatherAWA/the 24h panel here if you want the computed series too. Dashed line is a 10-minute rolling gust ceiling (sensor.apparent_wind_speed_max_10m, HA statistics platform on sensor.nmea_aws_live) — the short-window equivalent of the 6h gust max used elsewhere on this dashboard.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws_live")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sensor.nmea_aws_live")

from(bucket: "Sisu")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.apparent_wind_speed_max_10m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sensor.apparent_wind_speed_max_10m")

panels.title: Pressure Trend (3h)
panels.description: Now vs. ~3h ago. A steady fall is the classic front-approaching signal — worth more than the raw number.

targets.query:
cur = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "cur" }))
old = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -3h30m, stop: -2h30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "old" }))
union(tables: [cur, old])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with delta: r.cur - r.old }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "delta"])
  |> yield(name: "delta")
